title: Area 51 was only Groom Lake; Dreamland was Areas 53 and 54
place_text: Nevada test ranges (Groom Lake, Indian Springs Valley, Dog Bone Valley, French Peak)

tellings.quote: Area 51 was not actually Dreamland itself. It was merely Groom Lake. Dreamland was area 53 and 54,

plain: Area 51, the secret US test site in the Nevada desert, was "merely Groom Lake," a dry lakebed there, and the place known as Dreamland was really Areas 53 and 54, says a man named Charles Hall. Hall, who says he spent three years around 1965 on the Nevada test ranges living alongside tall white aliens, tells it from his own time there. If he is right, the most secret work happened outside the famous Area 51.
